description: Jet trainer on a circular white display pad in the grounds of the Cameroon Civil Aviation Authority headquarters beside the Yaounde-Nsimalen motorway. Recorded on OpenStreetMap as a memorial aircraft with the description Fouga Magister and visible on its pad in current Google satellite imagery; the surrounding compound is still a construction site in older imagery, so the installation is recent. A second airframe sits on a square pad about 60 m to the north-east but could not be identified and has no row. No serial found.
